bodySamples.sample:
<style>
    #container{
        padding: 10px;
        height: 100vh;
        overflow: auto;
        box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    .el-table .is-invalid-row {
        background-color: #f6f6f6;;
    }
    .el-form-item.center .el-form-item__label{
        line-height: 18px;
        text-align: right;
    }
    /* 文字提示框宽高最大值限制 */
    .el-popper:not(.el-select__popper):not(.el-popover) .el-select__selection{
        max-width: 450px !important;
        max-height: 300px !important;
        overflow-y: auto !important;
    }
    .ellipsis-4{
        display: -webkit-box;
        -webkit-line-clamp: 4;
        -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
        overflow: hidden;
        white-space: normal;
        word-break: break-word;
    }
    .el-table__body-wrapper .el-button.is-link{
        padding-left: 0;
    }
    /* 保存查询条件的样式 */
    .flex {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
    }
    .filterItem {
        box-sizing: border-box;
        border: 1px solid #b3d8ff;
        color: #409eff;
        padding: 0 5px;
        margin: 2px;
        border-radius: 3px;
        cursor: pointer;
        user-select: none;
        line-height: 20px;
    }

    .filterItem:hover {
        border-color: #409eff;
    }

    .filterItem i.rotate {
        transform: rotate(-180deg);
    }

    .filterItem .filterIcon {
        padding: 2px;
        cursor: pointer;
    }

    .filterItem .filterIcon:hover {
        background: #409eff;
        color: #fff;
        border-radius: 10px;
    }
    .none { display: none; }
</style>
